description: The canonical Tossing3D arm of ours (Model B, expectimax), shared by the sim and the robot. Planner: EXP-22c's, with the observation-probability weight at 0 (at its 0.1 default the w*(-ln p) charge makes STOP win at the priors) and tick-priced costs: one cost per control tick, the ticks coming from MuJoCo in the sim and from the robot's per-skill step costs on the robot, and 500 per human reset, at lambda = 3e-6. Step protocol only: give --practice-step-budget. Goal pursuit is off: under the step protocol a 100-step horizon spends the whole budget before the first practice decision.
